knowledge.text: ʻĀina Haina Elementary School celebrates its 75th anniversary on Sunday, September 20, 2026 from 4:00 to 6:30 PM at the school. Ti leaf garland making runs 4:00-5:00 PM and the cultural program starts at 5:30 PM. There are free carnival games, an Alumni Wall signing in the Library, and food and shave ice for purchase. All alumni, families, and community members are welcome and no RSVP is required. Guests are welcome to bring their own chairs and blankets; some chairs and tables are set up for kūpuna. The school was founded in Wailupe in 1951. Details and the alumni memory form are at https://ainahainapta.com/75th.

Pre-orders for 75th Anniversary luau bentos, shoyu chicken bentos, Spam musubi, and t-shirts have closed. Extra shirts and bentos will be available for purchase at the event on September 20, 2026, and a separate food truck and Shred Shave Ice will also be on site for purchase. Use the live order form list to confirm whether any form is still open, and never quote a price or deadline that is not in that list.

The PTA needs help preparing for the 75th Anniversary Celebration. Ti leaves: drop them off at the ʻĀina Haina Elementary front office any day from Tuesday, September 15 through Friday, September 18, 2026 and give them to Aja. They do not need to be deboned. Ti leaf garlands to decorate the school are made together at the event from 4:00 to 5:00 PM; anyone joining that should bring their own scissors.
PTA membership is $10 per year and any parent, guardian, teacher, or community member can join. Sign up at https://ainahainapta.com/join.
Membership dues, donations, and other PTA payments can be made by credit or debit card at https://ainahainapta.com/pay. Donations of any size are welcome and go directly to student programs.

Jaguar Jog is the PTA's largest fundraiser of the year, a fun run where students collect pledges. The campaign page is at https://ainahainapta.com/jaguar-jog, donations at https://ainahainapta.com/jaguar-jog/donate, and a student's personal page can be looked up by student number at https://ainahainapta.com/jog.

PTA meetings are held monthly at 6:00 PM, either in the ʻĀina Haina Elementary School library or on Zoom at https://api.ainahainapta.com/meet. Everyone is welcome to attend, and the meeting schedule is on the homepage.
Money the PTA raises pays for part time teachers, classroom supplies, technology supplies, teacher training, and student programs and experiences.
The PTA always needs volunteers for events, and families can sign up at https://ainahainapta.com/volunteer or email info@ainahainapta.com to ask what help is needed.
